It marks a fundamental paradigm shift in multimodal AI: from modality integration to true unification. sources.title: SenseNova Launches U1.5 8B Open Source Model, First to Match Nano ...
sources.snippet: This newest multimodal deployment allows the developer community to download and optimize the underlying architecture. The U1.5-8B-MoT system matches Nano Banana 2 on performance benchmarks and utilizes a mixture of transformers to denoise in pixel space. The 8B parameter release comes under an Apache 2 license to encourage public testing and optimization.
